title: Automated Protocol Execution for JSON Processing
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Load deck and consumables
steps.instruction: Load the following items onto the OT‑2 deck: Opentrons P300‑multi channel electronic pipette (GEN2), Opentrons 200 µL filter tips, Opentrons P1000‑single channel electronic pipette (GEN2), Opentrons 1000 µL filter tips, Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tube rack set, Bio‑Rad hard‑shell 96‑well PCR plates low‑profile thin‑wall skirted, Opentrons aluminum block set, and generic 0.2 mL 12‑tube PCR strips.
